Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var inputJson = "{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/report.txt\"}";
        var input = JsonUtil.fromJson(inputJson, ExtractInput.class);
        var configJson = "{\"captioning\":{\"llm\":{\"max_concurrency\":2,\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"},\"min_image_area\":1000},\"concurrency\":{\"max_threads\":8}}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ExtractionConfig.class);
        var result = Xberg.extract(input, config);
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).mimeType());
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).content());
    }
}
```
